fragments.name: distinct-case.md
fragments.text:
### Added

- `files/distinct-case` reports two files or folders in one folder whose names, or the files they build to, differ only by case, such as `ReadingHistory.tsx` and `readingHistory.ts`. On macOS or Windows such a pair is one path, so a checkout or a build fails. A repository that upgrades records its existing findings with `quality baseline write --rule files/distinct-case`.

fragments.name: railway-config-files.md
fragments.text:
### Fixed

- Treat `.railway/railway.ts` and its `.py` and `.go` siblings as tool config files at any project root: `files/named-after-export` leaves them alone and the shared Biome preset permits their default export. Other files in `.railway/` and `src/railway.ts` remain checked.
